'**Go again** / When this enters the arena, each hero draws a card. / At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this, then the next Guardian attack action card you play this turn gets +3{p}.' Guardian Action - Aura.

GO AGAIN NOT AUTHORED: GoAgain is an UNCONDITIONAL line of the printed text and appears in printed_keywords - it fires from the card DB keywords field; re-authoring it would be a defect. No conditional-keyword (SOURCE_IS_ATTACK) machinery applies because nothing gates it.

ETB DRAW: TRIGGERED ON_ENTER_PLAY, dispatched from Zone.add on real arena entry from a non-arena zone (state.py:304-310) - covers BOTH release-note-1 paths: resolving on the stack when played AND being put into the arena by another card's effect. 'Each hero draws a card' is the documented two-effect shape - DRAW SELF + DRAW OPPONENT (DSL_REFERENCE Draw/Discard) - ordered SELF first, matching release note 1 ('in clockwise order beginning with the controller'). Release note 3 (no priority between the draws) is plain sequential resolution of one effects list. DRAW handler reads amount/player (effect_types.py:1222-1249).

UPKEEP TRIGGER: START_OF_ACTION_PHASE, not START_OF_TURN - 'at the beginning of your ACTION PHASE' is CR 4.3.1 wording and trigger_types.py:56-58 maps exactly that phrase; the corpus review files flag START_OF_TURN for this wording as wrong-timing (one sub-phase early). Dispatched to the ACTIVE player's permanent zones INCLUDING player.auras (engine.py:1514-1522, _dsl_permanent_zones at :1452), so the aura fires on its controller's action phase only - 'your action phase'; no IS_ACTIVE_PLAYER gate, same as crash_down_yellow (same clause family, +5{p}).

ORDER: DESTROY_SELF first, then the pump, following the printed sentence; release note 3 ('no priority between destroying Draw a Crowd and generating the continuous effect') is plain in-order resolution with nothing between them. Destroying first cannot unqueue the pump: the mod lives on the CONTROLLER's dsl_queued_attack_mods, not on the card.

PUMP: MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK reads mod/amount/filter/scope (effect_types.py:4592-4618) and queues a one-shot entry consumed by the first matching attack; unused entries expire end of turn = 'this turn'; scope left at default TURN. Filter names 'Guardian attack action card', each key read out of its handler this session: ATTACK_CLASS_IN reads 'classes' and matches them against the attack card's classes AND talents via _card_traits (condition_types.py:204-216); ATTACK_TYPE_IN reads 'types' and tests types AND subtypes merged (273-294); ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN reads 'subtypes' (296+). An attack action card is types=['Action'], subtypes=['Attack']; a weapon attack carries type Weapon and fails the Action test, so the buff cannot land on a weapon attack - exactly the printed restriction.

Adoption note: batch lists set MasteryPackGuardian - file under that set's folder at adoption time.
